title: Thorfinn Workout: Vinland Saga Speed and Strength Plan
lead: Thorfinn is small, fast and dangerous. This 8-week plan builds that relative-strength, sprint-ready body with a pull-up bar, a pair of dumbbells and a running base.
meta: 10 min read · Level: Intermediate · 8 weeks · Updated Oct 22, 2026
gear: Doorway pull-up bar
Pull-ups, chin-ups and dead hangs. Climbing strength starts here.
Adjustable dumbbells
Bulgarian split squats, Romanian deadlifts and push presses need weight that grows with you.
Slam ball or medicine ball
For rotational throws on the speed day. A heavy backpack works if you don't have one.
excerpt: An 8-week Vinland Saga workout: pull and single-leg strength, a sprint and bound speed day, and a running base for Thorfinn's lean, fast build.

title: Rock Lee Workout: Naruto Taijutsu Training, Made Realistic

Push-ups, hollow holds and kicks on a surface that's kind to your joints.

title: Yujiro Hanma Workout: The Ogre's Back Specialization Program
lead: Nobody gets the Demon Back. But a wide, thick back is the most powerful-looking thing you can build at home. This 12-week program trains it three times a week while everything else grows too.
meta: 11 min read · Level: Intermediate · 12 weeks · Updated Oct 22, 2026
gear: Doorway pull-up bar
Weighted pull-ups and chin-ups are the backbone of back width.
Adjustable dumbbells
Rows, shrugs, pullovers and Romanian deadlifts for thickness.
Adjustable bench
Chest-supported rows and pullovers, the two moves that isolate your back best.
excerpt: A 12-week Yujiro Hanma workout built around the back: width, thickness and carries three times a week, with dumbbells and a pull-up bar.
